text:
jules_engineer: deploybot alerted a quality drop for the quantized v3.5-lite on canary (/generate). Autorevert will run in ~90s. Can we try a quick re-quant profile before letting it flip?

deploybot: ALERT: Canary generation quality score down 12% vs baseline for route /generate. Autorevert in 90s unless overridden. details: https://telemetry/quality/1758012

kai_oncall: oncall here. Are errors or just quality numbers?

jules_engineer: just quality metrics (nucleus/ROUGE-style) — no 5xx. The new quant profile QP-9 appears to produce tokenization drift for longer contexts. I can re-run quant with QP-8 which historically preserved quality.

sam_ops: if you want the hold, apply it now so deploybot doesn't autorevert while you test. Also prepare a pin command in case we need to contain prod traffic.

kai_oncall: applying short hold. `deploybot override --thread 1758012345 --hold 600 --reason "re-quant attempt"`

deploybot: ACTION: Autorevert HOLD applied by kai_oncall for 600s. Manual rollback still allowed.

jules_engineer: re-quant started at 1758012370. Command: `quant-tool profile --model v3.5-lite --profile QP-8 --out v3.5-lite-q8`

jules_engineer: re-quant finished and deployed to canary at 1758012398. Smoke eval: `smoke: quality delta -1.8% (within threshold); p95 latency +0.02s`

tara_pm: draft CSM note: "We observed a temporary quality regression on a canary quantized build. We held automated rollback, applied a corrected quant profile and verified no prod impact."

sam_ops: sounds good. If promote succeeds, remember to include changelog entry and the quant profile ID.

jules_engineer: promoted fixed quant to canary green at 1758012410. Posting PR link to #release-notes.

kai_oncall: canceling hold. `deploybot override --thread 1758012345 --hold-cancel`

deploybot: NOTICE: Autorevert HOLD canceled by kai_oncall. Normal autorevert policy restored.

jules_engineer: opening a follow-up ticket to add quant-profile regression checks to the canary eval harness. Closing thread."
